name: .alpha.-tocopherol + aloe + witch hazel + zinc oxide
purpose: Purpose Relieve itching and pain Reduces swelling, anti-inflammatory. Promotes wound healing. Moisturizing, repairing, anti-inflammatory.
uses: Use 1.Helps relieve the pain, itching and burning associated with hemorrhoids 2.Temporarily reduces the swelling associated with hemorrhoids and fissues 3.Temporarily protects irritated areas and inflamed perinatal skin
otcwarn: Do not use 1. Do not use the product with an applicator if the introduction of the applicator into the rectum causes additional pain. Consult a doctor promptly. 2. Do not use if allergic to any of the ingredients, for pregnant or breast-feeding,ask a health professional before use. Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens or does not improve within 7 days or bleeding occurs.
